name: Roblox Talent Show ☀️
desc:
🎤 Welcome to Roblox Talent Show, the largest and most innovative talent competition game on the Roblox platform! Present your talent in front of the Judges and earn a rating based on your performance!

☀️ SUMMER IS HERE! Featuring:
- Summer Event: daily quests, summer rewards
- TRIOS, priority queue, gifting priority passes
- COMPLETE PIANO OVERHAUL!
+ much MUCH more!

Within Roblox Talent Show, you can:
🎉 Take the stage in front of the Judges!
😃 Become the Host and manage the game!
❤️ Audition alongside your friends!
💸 Receive Robux donations as a performer from other players!
